$comment: Routing table of the SMard Arsenal Gate. Edit freely; the gate reloads it on every hook call. A route fires when the prompt matches any `prompt` regex, when an edited file matches any `paths` regex, or when a Bash command matches any `bash` regex. While a fired route is unsatisfied, the tools listed in `gate` are denied; `requires.any_of` is satisfied by invoking any one of the listed skills (Skill tool) or calling any one of the listed tools. Set `gate` to [] for advisory-only routes (context injected, nothing denied).

routes.title: SMard method (requirement, ADR, spec, delegation, PR, handoff)
PostgreSQL / pgvector work consults pg-aiguide first
Rust engine work goes through the Rust CLI skills
Hot-path, codegen or performance claims about Rust/C/C++ are checked in Compiler Explorer before editing
Skills, hooks, plugins and agents are edited with the plugin-dev / writing-skills skills
A reported failure is debugged systematically before anything is edited
New work starts with brainstorming (advisory: context only, nothing denied)

error_loop.$comment: Same error signature (tool + normalized message) repeated in one session. At `warn` the gate injects a stop-and-diagnose instruction; at `block` it denies the failing tool until one of `requires` was invoked.

stop_gate.$comment: If files were edited and no verification command ran since the last edit, the Stop is blocked (at most `max_blocks` times per session, then it passes with a warning).

reply_prefix.$comment: Optional: require the first line of every final reply to start with `prefix` (e.g. the HANDSHAKE gate line). Off by default; the project turns it on.

session_banner.$comment: Short index injected at SessionStart. Keep under 40 lines; this is what replaces long always-on instruction blocks.
lines: SMARD ARSENAL GATE is active in this session (deterministic hooks, no LLM).

Rules it enforces: (1) prompts matching a route must invoke one of that route's skills/tools BEFORE Edit/Write; the gate denies the edit otherwise and names the skill. (2) The same error repeated 2x triggers a mandatory systematic-debugging stop; 3x denies the failing tool until debugging was invoked. (3) Stopping after edits without a verification command is blocked.
Invoke skills with the Skill tool using the exact name shown in the denial reason. The denial reason is the instruction; do not argue with it, satisfy it.
To see routes and state: Skill arsenal-gate (user-invocable /arsenal-gate).
